description: List the tables in a Tabular knowledge base with their columns, types, and row counts — so a model can discover the schema before writing SQL for the Query Knowledge Base node. Wire a Knowledge Base node into knowledge_base, same as the other KB nodes. Returns [] for a docs KB.

inputs.name: knowledge_base
inputs.description: The knowledge base to describe, from a Knowledge Base node. If omitted, falls back to the flow's default knowledge base.

outputs.name: tables
outputs.description: [{ table_name, source_name, row_count, columns: [{ name, type }] }]
